response.overview: In Bulleji, a fishing village on the edge of Karachi, a fisherman’s son dreams of a life his father cannot picture for him: one on a surfboard. 22-year-old Attiq Rehman is caught between the duty inherited from generations of fishermen before him and the pull of his own ambition – to put Pakistani surfing on the map. This is a beautiful and life affirming portrait exploring duty, desire and the grit it takes to imagine a life no one around you has lived.
response.title: Bulleji Boys
